projects.title: Bangla Hate Speech Detection (CSE 3200 Project)
description: Built a **BiLSTM model** using a 5K self-collected dataset for detecting Bangla hate comments.
Applied **TF-IDF vectorization**, comprehensive preprocessing techniques, and evaluated model performance using precision & recall metrics.
Achieved significant accuracy in identifying hate speech patterns in Bengali language text.
projects.tools: Python, BiLSTM, TF-IDF, Natural Language Processing

projects.title: Luminous Learners Portal (CSE 3100 Project)
description: Developed a comprehensive **study portal website** for educational management.
Built using **Django framework** with responsive design using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
Features include lecture management, notes organization, assignment tracking, and e-resources repository.
projects.tools: Django, Python, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, SQLite

projects.title: Hotel Management System (CSE 2100 Project)
description: Created a **Java-based GUI hotel management system** with comprehensive functionality.
Implemented billing system, reservation management, and file handling capabilities.
Designed with **Object-Oriented Programming principles** ensuring modular and maintainable code architecture.
projects.tools: Java, Swing, OOP, File Handling, GUI Development

projects.title: Gender Abusive Language Detection Research
description: Conducted research on **Gender Abusive Language Detection in Bengali** using machine learning algorithms.
Published findings in the **2nd International Conference on Big Data, IoT and Machine Learning** by Springer.
Developed models to identify and classify abusive language patterns targeting gender-based harassment.
projects.tools: Python, Machine Learning, NLP, Bengali Language Processing, Research Methodology
